test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the defining feature of Epic Theatre according to Brecht's theory?

options.text: A plot that is closely woven together and thus conjures up a strong illusion of reality along with emotional identification
An emphasis on melodrama and sentimental storytelling in order to evoke empathy
A series of loosely connected scenes that break the illusion and encourage critical thinking
The use of improvisation as the only means of comunication without any structured narrative.

solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ***Option 3: A series of loosely connected scenes that break the illusion and encourage critical thinking.***

 
 
• The passage defines Epic Theatre as a **"mode of instructive theatre"** consisting of **"not so tightly knit scenes."** This matches the "loosely connected" description.
 
• It states this form **"refrained from creating an illusion"** and frequently broke the plot to speak directly to spectators with **"analysis, argument, or evidence."**
